test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a scheme or initiative run by Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports?

options.text: Shyama Prasad Mukherjee National Sports Welfare Fund

solution:
The correct answer is __**Shyama Prasad Mukherjee National Sports Welfare Fund**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Shyama Prasad Mukherjee National Sports Welfare Fund is not run by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• It is a fund set up to provide financial assistance to outstanding sportspersons for medical treatment, support to their families, and other purposes.
 
• This fund is managed by the Department of Sports under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• Other schemes like National Sports Development Fund, Khelo India Scheme, and National Sports Awards are directly managed by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Sports Development Fund (NSDF)**

 
 
• Established in 1998 with the aim of mobilizing resources from the government and non-government sectors for the promotion of sports.
 
• Provides financial assistance to sportspersons, sports federations, and other organizations for training and development.
 
• The fund is maintained by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
 
 
• **Khelo India Scheme**
 
 
• Launched in 2018 to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• Aims to build a strong framework for all sports played in our country and establish India as a great sporting nation.
 
• Includes the Khelo India Youth Games and Khelo India University Games.
 
 
 
• **National Sports Awards**
 
 
• Includes awards such as Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna, Arjuna Award, Dronacharya Award, and Dhyan Chand Award.
 
• Awards are given annually to recognize and reward excellence in sports.
 
• Managed by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
